docs.text:
From: Helen Park, Office Manager
To: All staff, Westbrook Design
Date: April 8
Subject: Kitchen improvements

Dear all,

I am pleased to let you know that the second-floor kitchen will be improved next week. The work will begin on Monday, April 15, and should be finished by Thursday, April 18. During this time, the kitchen will be closed, but the coffee machine in the third-floor meeting area will be available to everyone.

The improvements include a larger refrigerator, a new dishwasher, and two more microwave ovens. These changes are a direct result of the comments many of you made in last month's staff survey.

Before the work begins, please remove all personal items, including food and cups, from the kitchen by 5 P.M. on Friday, April 12. Anything left after that time will be thrown away.

Thank you,
Helen

NORTH BAY (October 3) — The Lakeside Public Library opened its new Digital Learning Center on Saturday. — [1] — The center, located on the library's second floor, offers twenty computers, two printers, and a recording room for local residents.

The project was paid for by money from the Harmon Foundation, along with gifts from several local businesses. — [2] — Library director Sandra Cole said the center was designed for people of all ages. "Many residents told us they wanted help with basic computer skills," she said. "Others wanted a quiet place to work on job applications." — [3] —

Free classes will be held every Tuesday and Thursday evening, starting October 10. Topics include using e-mail, writing a résumé, and keeping personal information safe online. Each class is limited to twelve people, so residents should sign up at the information desk. — [4] —

A.why_zh: attend 搭配会议/活动（attend a meeting）

B.why_zh: achieve 搭配目标/结果（achieve a goal），不说 achieve a form

C.why_zh: perform 搭配任务/表演（perform a task）

items.explain_zh: 四个都是动词 → 词汇题。宾语是 the attached form（附件表格），“填写表格”固定说 complete a form，所以选 complete。
items.stem: Please ------- the attached form and return it to the front desk by Friday.

A.why_zh: receipt 是收据，不能是“10%”

C.why_zh: deposit 是押金/定金，不是优惠

D.why_zh: budget 是预算，和顾客下次购物无关

items.explain_zh: 线索是 10 percent 和 next purchase：消费满 50 美元，下次购物打九折，“折扣”= discount。
items.stem: Customers who spend more than $50 will receive a 10 percent ------- on their next purchase.

B.why_zh: complementary 是“互补的”，只差一个字母的形近词

C.why_zh: previous 是“之前的”，“之前的早餐”不通

D.why_zh: considerate 是“体贴的”，形容人，不形容早餐

items.explain_zh: 酒店给直接在官网订房的客人提供“免费”早餐，complimentary = free。小心形近词 complementary（互补的）。
items.stem: The hotel offers ------- breakfast to all guests who book directly through its Web site.

vocab_exceptions.complementary: 形近词陷阱即考点（complimentary vs complementary），仅作干扰项出现

A.why_zh: highly 修饰程度（highly recommended），不修饰时间

B.why_zh: closely 是“密切地/仔细地”，不是“不久”

D.why_zh: nearly 是“几乎”，不放在 after 前表示时间

items.explain_zh: shortly after = “……之后不久”，是固定的时间表达。航班晚点，所以演讲开始后不久才到。
items.stem: Mr. Patel's flight was delayed, so he arrived ------- after the presentation had started.

B.why_zh: contain 是“包含”，人不能 contain 项目

C.why_zh: attract 是“吸引”，意思不通

D.why_zh: operate 搭配机器/设备（operate a machine），不搭 projects

items.explain_zh: 招聘要求：能同时“管理”好几个项目，manage projects 是固定搭配。
items.stem: The position requires the ability to ------- several projects at the same time.

A.why_zh: attendance 是出席人数/出席，不会被“延长到某天”

C.why_zh: location 是地点，和延长日期无关

D.why_zh: invitation 是邀请，不是可延长的期限

items.explain_zh: 因为报名的人多，“报名”截止被延长到 4 月 12 日。has been extended until + 日期，能被延长的是 registration（报名期）。
items.stem: Due to high demand, ------- for the marketing workshop has been extended until April 12.

A.why_zh: aware 后接 of，且主语要是人

B.why_zh: capable 后接 of，不接 for

D.why_zh: responsible for 是“负责”，主语要是人，费用不能负责

items.explain_zh: be eligible for = “有资格获得”：交了收据，差旅费就“可以报销”。看形容词后面的介词 for 和主语（费用）。
items.stem: All travel costs are ------- for reimbursement if receipts are submitted within 30 days.

A.why_zh: hardly 是“几乎不”，和“下周重新开放”矛盾

B.why_zh: closely 是“密切地”，不能修饰 complete

C.why_zh: lately 是“最近”，不修饰 complete 的程度

items.explain_zh: 大厅工程“快”完成了，所以下周入口重开。nearly complete = almost finished。
items.stem: The work on the lobby is ------- complete, and the main entrance will reopen next week.

A.why_zh: reply 后要加 to 才能接对象

C.why_zh: inform 是“通知某人某事”，要 inform sb of sth，这里缺内容且意思不对

D.why_zh: respond 是不及物动词，要说 respond to

items.explain_zh: 空格后直接接宾语 our customer service team，“联系客服”用及物动词 contact。respond/reply 都要加 to。
items.stem: If your package has not arrived within five business days, please ------- our customer service team.

B.why_zh: requirements 是要求，和 report…immediately 不搭

C.why_zh: solutions 是解决办法，员工不用向技术部报告“办法”

D.why_zh: conditions 是条件/状况，意思不具体

items.explain_zh: 电脑有“问题”要马上报告给技术部，problems with 是常见搭配。
items.stem: Employees should report any ------- with their computers to the IT help desk immediately.

A.why_zh: urgent 是“紧急的”，意思不对

B.why_zh: frequent 是“频繁的”，不说 frequent growth

C.why_zh: eager 形容人“渴望的”，不修饰 growth

items.explain_zh: 因为在亚洲“快速”增长，所以要开新办公室。rapid growth 是固定搭配。
items.stem: Thanks to its ------- growth in Asia, Delmont Electronics plans to open three new offices next year.

A.why_zh: canceled 是取消，取消了就不会再“到下周四”

B.why_zh: attended 是出席，不能接 until next Thursday

D.why_zh: located 是“位于”，意思不通

items.explain_zh: 几位董事在出差，所以会议“推迟”到下周四。postpone … until + 时间。
items.stem: The board meeting has been ------- until next Thursday because several members are traveling.

A.why_zh: permission 是许可，和道歉无关

B.why_zh: advantage 是好处，不需要道歉

D.why_zh: occasion 是场合，意思不通

items.explain_zh: apologize for any inconvenience 是商务道歉套话：停车场临时关闭给您“带来不便”，深表歉意。
items.stem: We apologize for any ------- caused by the temporary closure of our parking area.

B.why_zh: in case of 是“万一……”，意思不对

C.why_zh: in addition to 是“除了……之外”，介词是 to

D.why_zh: in order to 后接动词原形，不接 of

items.explain_zh: in charge of = 负责。Kim 女士将负责新销售人员的培训项目。
items.stem: Ms. Kim will be in ------- of the training program for new sales staff.

A.why_zh: talk 要加 about，而且“谈论投诉”不是目的

B.why_zh: express 是“表达”，经理不会去“表达”顾客投诉

C.why_zh: reply 要说 reply to complaints，不能直接接宾语

items.explain_zh: address 的商务义 = 处理、解决（deal with）。address complaints = 处理投诉。这是“常见词的商务义”考点。
items.stem: The new manager plans to ------- customer complaints more quickly by hiring two more staff members.

A.why_zh: even 是“甚至”，放在这里意思不通

C.why_zh: almost 是“几乎”，不说“几乎对会员开放”

D.why_zh: quite 修饰形容词程度，不修饰 until 短语

items.explain_zh: only until = “只到……为止”：新展览只对会员开放到 5 月底。焦点副词 only 限定范围。
items.stem: The museum's new exhibit is open to members ------- until the end of May.

B.why_zh: install 是动词，不能放在 The … of 之间

C.why_zh: installs 是动词三单

D.why_zh: installed 是过去式/分词，不能作主语中心词

items.explain_zh: The ------- of：冠词 the 后、介词 of 前 → 名词。-tion 结尾是名词，选 installation。
items.stem: The ------- of the new payment system took less time than expected.

A.why_zh: information 是名词，information tours 不成立

C.why_zh: inform 是动词

D.why_zh: 副词不能修饰名词 tours

items.explain_zh: 空格在名词 tours 前 → 形容词。-ive 结尾是形容词，选 informative（内容丰富的）。
items.stem: Brightway Travel offers ------- tours of the city's historic district every weekend.

A.why_zh: careful 是形容词，不能修饰动词 read

B.why_zh: caring 是形容词“关心人的”

D.why_zh: care 是名词/动词

items.explain_zh: read the instructions 已经是完整的“动词+宾语”，后面再加的修饰动作 → 副词 carefully。
items.stem: Please read the safety instructions ------- before using the equipment.

A.why_zh: 名词复数

B.why_zh: 副词不能作宾语补足语

C.why_zh: convenience 是名词，very 后不接名词

items.explain_zh: find + 宾语 + 形容词（觉得某物怎么样）。very 后也要形容词，选 convenient。
items.stem: Customers have found the new online ordering system very -------.

A.why_zh: attendance 是“出席”这件事，不能 wear name cards

C.why_zh: attend 是动词

D.why_zh: attended 是过去式/分词

items.explain_zh: All 后要名词，而且要“戴名牌”的是人 → 人名词 attendees（参会者）。attendance 是事物名词。
items.stem: All ------- at the conference must wear their name cards at all times.

A.why_zh: surprised 是形容人的情感分词

B.why_zh: 形容词不能修饰另一个形容词 simple

D.why_zh: 名词/动词

items.explain_zh: 空格修饰形容词 simple → 副词。surprisingly simple = 出乎意料地简单。
items.stem: The instructions for the new printer are ------- simple to follow.

B.why_zh: 动词原形不能放在所有格 her 后

C.why_zh: 过去式/分词

D.why_zh: 动词三单

items.explain_zh: 所有格 her 后 → 名词。contribution to = 对……的贡献。
items.stem: Ms. Lopez received an award for her ------- to the company's recycling program.

A.why_zh: applicable 是形容词“适用的”

B.why_zh: 过去式/分词不能当主语

C.why_zh: 动词原形不能当主语

items.explain_zh: 句子缺主语，谓语是 must be received → 主语是名词。被“收到”的是申请材料 Applications。
items.stem: ------- for the summer internship must be received by May 15.

B.why_zh: 形容词不能修饰动词

C.why_zh: 名词不能插在 has 和 completed 之间

D.why_zh: 动词原形

items.explain_zh: has ------- completed：助动词和过去分词之间 → 副词 successfully。
items.stem: The marketing team has ------- completed its review of the new advertising plan.

A.why_zh: 名词，句子会没有谓语

B.why_zh: -ing 不能单独作谓语

D.why_zh: to do 不能作谓语

items.explain_zh: 剥掉修饰：The head … ------- the figures。句子没有谓语 → 填动词；主语 head 是单数，用 presents。
items.stem: The head of the sales department ------- the monthly figures at every staff meeting.

A.why_zh: 动词原形不能放在 were 后

C.why_zh: 名词，were pleasure by 不通

D.why_zh: pleasing 是“令人愉快的”，形容事物

items.explain_zh: 人“感到高兴”用 -ed：staff were pleased by …。-ing（pleasing）形容让人高兴的事物。
items.stem: The staff were ------- by the number of positive comments from customers.

A.why_zh: purchaser 是购买者，人不能修饰 receipt

B.why_zh: 复合名词的前一个名词一般用单数

C.why_zh: purchased receipt 是“被买的收据”，意思错

items.explain_zh: 复合名词：purchase receipt = 购物小票。名词修饰名词时，前面的名词用单数。
items.stem: Please keep your ------- receipt as proof that you paid for the item.

A.why_zh: 名词复数

C.why_zh: 名词

D.why_zh: 形容词不能单独放句首加逗号修饰全句

items.explain_zh: 句首 + 逗号，后面是完整句子 → 修饰全句的副词 Fortunately（幸运的是）。
items.stem: -------, the shipment from our overseas supplier arrived two days ahead of schedule.

A.why_zh: 过去式/分词

B.why_zh: advise 是动词

C.why_zh: advice 不可数，没有复数

items.explain_zh: provide 后要名词 → advice（建议，不可数）。advise 是动词，advices 不存在。
items.stem: Our team can provide ------- on how to reduce energy costs in your building.

A.why_zh: 主动进行时，语态和时态都错

B.why_zh: 规则不会自己“发送”，要用被动

D.why_zh: last Monday 是过去，而且语态也错

items.explain_zh: 两步：①规则是“被发送” → 被动；②last Monday → 过去时。合起来 were sent。
items.stem: The new parking rules ------- to all employees by e-mail last Monday.

B.why_zh: 现在完成时到“现在”为止，但她已经离开银行

C.why_zh: 一般现在时，和 before she joined 冲突

D.why_zh: 将来时，完全不对

items.explain_zh: before she joined（过去）之前已经持续了十年 → “过去的过去”用过去完成时 had worked。
items.stem: Ms. Grant ------- at Lakeview Bank for over ten years before she joined our company.

A.why_zh: 原形不能直接作谓语

B.why_zh: -ing 不能作谓语

C.why_zh: 被 suppliers 骗了，真正的主语是 list（单数）

items.explain_zh: 剥掉 of approved suppliers，主语是 The list（单数）→ is。
items.stem: The list of approved suppliers ------- updated every three months.

A.why_zh: 名词，从句缺谓语

C.why_zh: 从句需要谓语

D.why_zh: 时间从句里不用 will，用一般现在时表将来

items.explain_zh: as soon as 引导时间从句：主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时代替将来 → approves。
items.stem: As soon as the director ------- the budget, we will begin ordering new equipment.

A.why_zh: 过去进行时

B.why_zh: 现在完成时不和 next month 连用

D.why_zh: 过去时，和 next month 冲突

items.explain_zh: 时间状语 next month → 将来时 will visit。
items.stem: Mr. Chen ------- our new branch in Busan next month.

B.why_zh: 过去式

C.why_zh: 看起来要三单，但 request that 从句要用原形

D.why_zh: 从句缺谓语

She will print the brochures at the office.
She wants Mr. Ortega to stop working on the task.
She will send the design files.

A.why_zh: 他是让对方下周送，不是取消

C.why_zh: 这是 Rita 要做的

options: Call the print shop on Elm Street
items.q: What will Mr. Grant most likely do next?

B.why_zh: 带课的是 Kevin Moss 等人

C.why_zh: 没提退会

options: To ask to change a workshop
To offer to lead a workshop

C.why_zh: 4 月 4 日的课他没报

items.explain_zh: 邮件：4 月 11 日下午要见供应商。网页：4 月 11 日下午 1–3 点是 Hiring Your First Employee → 他要退的是这节。要两篇对照。
items.q: Which workshop does Mr. Haddad want to stop attending?

A.why_zh: 他说已经付了会员价

B.why_zh: 他说自己是会员

C.why_zh: 两篇都没提满员

items.explain_zh: 网页规定修改要在每个工作坊前至少 3 天；Kevin Moss 的课在 4 月 4 日，他 4 月 2 日才写信（只提前 2 天）→ 太晚了。
options: He has not paid for any workshops.
He is not a forum member.
He did not write early enough.
items.q: Why might Mr. Haddad's request be refused?

A.why_zh: 见供应商是邮件里的安排

B.why_zh: 没说线上

C.why_zh: 开新店是邮件里 Haddad 的事

items.q: In the e-mail, the word "switch" in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to

B.why_zh: 两天送达是 Express delivery 的特点

items.explain_zh: 网页 Premium (thick, high-quality paper) → 纸更厚：thick → thicker paper。
options: They are printed on thicker paper.
They are delivered in two days.
They always include a free design.
items.q: According to the Web page, what is true about Premium cards?

B.why_zh: 设计费是按新设计收的，她没有对此提出问题

D.why_zh: 总价会跟着变，但她指的是其中那一项

items.explain_zh: 邮件说她选的是 regular delivery（普通配送，网页写免费），发票却收了 Express delivery $15 → 错的是 $15。
items.q: Which amount on the invoice does Ms. Chen believe is a mistake?

A.why_zh: 发票写的是 Premium，plain 是 Standard

C.why_zh: 她没抱怨送晚了

D.why_zh: 发票上是 1,000 张

items.explain_zh: 网页：Premium 每 500 张 $45；发票：1,000 张收 $90 = 2 × 45，价格对。要网页 + 发票对照。
options: It was printed on plain paper.
The price of the cards was correct.
It arrived later than she expected.
items.q: What is suggested about Ms. Chen's first order?

B.why_zh: 多加了快递费 $15，但她要普通配送

C.why_zh: 多加了设计费 $20，但用的是已有设计

D.why_zh: 按高级纸算了，她要的是便宜的纸

items.explain_zh: 新单：1,000 张便宜的纸（Standard，$30/500）= $60；用旧设计 → 不收设计费；普通配送 → 免费。合计 $60。
items.q: How much will Ms. Chen most likely pay for her new order?

A.why_zh: 她说很满意设计

B.why_zh: 没提搬家

C.why_zh: 没提

Her company has moved to a new office.
She lost her first set of cards.
New employees have joined her company.
